prompt.project_info: Create a high-fashion 4:5 studio portrait of one approved adult man in a classic tuxedo against a fully deep-red seamless environment with a three-echo motion effect.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man with short styled slightly tousled hair, well-groomed short beard or stubble, serious confident gaze, black tuxedo jacket with sharp lapels, white pleated dress shirt, black bow tie, white pocket square, watch, and optional subtle ring.
composition_elements: Main subject leans or sits with torso slightly angled; one hand is raised near the face with fingers softly bent and the other rests near the waist.
Three translucent offset duplicates trail to the right as a controlled motion echo while the main face remains sharp and dominant.
Solid deep-red studio cyclorama and red floor create a monochrome red environment with true black and clean white wardrobe accents.
Keep the main face, tuxedo texture, watch, hand anatomy, and echo direction consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard studio key from forward-left slightly above eye level with a beauty dish or small softbox, very light fill, faint rim against the red background, high contrast, controlled highlights, and natural skin under red bounce.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 three-quarter portrait, 85mm portrait compression, medium-shallow depth of field, face tack sharp, editorial crisp fabric texture, subtle analog grain, no text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion 4:5 studio portrait of one approved adult man with short styled slightly tousled hair, well-groomed short beard or stubble, serious confident gaze, black tuxedo jacket with sharp lapels, white pleated dress shirt, black bow tie, white pocket square, and a watch. He leans or sits with torso slightly angled, one hand raised near the face and the other near the waist. Add exactly three translucent offset duplicates trailing to the right as a controlled multi-exposure motion echo; keep the main face sharp and dominant and echoes softer and semi-transparent. Use a fully deep-red seamless cyclorama and red floor, hard key from forward-left slightly above eye level, very light fill, faint rim, high contrast, natural skin under red bounce, 85mm portrait compression, 4:5 composition, subtle analog grain, no text, logos, or watermark.
